questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: In Milan the teachers were just sitting behind the desk speaking for hours often without breaks or only a short break and often very boring, no interaction from the students. And when they finally asked a question to us, if noone answered quickly they just went on. So often I didnt have enough time to find out what I wanted to ask them :-)

questions.answer:
Elements of Christian Culture
Indian Art
Art and Law
Phonenician and Punic Archaeology
Chinese Thought

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
the Art and Law was very interesting, the combination of an italian lawyer and an american art historian really worked well, and all the remote teachers they had planned also went well. Sharon Hecker was a good teacher, where the italian lawyer was like the other italian teachers just sititng behind her desk reading aloud. Maybe a cultural difference. But anyways the course was excellent. Though they didnt upload the teaching material and the powerpoints until just before the exam, even if we asked many times they didnt do it. Really sloppy, if you ask me.

Chinese thought was also very insteresting, as I didnt know anything about this topic. Really nice teachers. Good powerpoints and good exam.
